target: 话题相同不等于双向衔接
q:
前文：Local farmers and engineers spent three years designing a sensor that could measure soil moisture, temperature and rainfall.
【空缺】
后文：Today this linked network lets dozens of villages compare conditions in real time.
哪一句最适合填入？
o: A photo-sharing app lets farmers combine pictures and short videos into attractive posts.
They then connected the sensors to a shared network that automatically exchanged readings.
Rainfall is usually lower in the eastern villages than in the western ones.
Some local farmers prefer older methods of recording the weather.

exp.trans: 前文介绍农民和工程师共同开发传感器；正确衔接句说明他们随后把传感器接入共享网络；后文再说这个联网系统让许多村庄实时比较天气条件。
exp.structure: 前文Local farmers and engineers是复数施动者；正确句They回指这群人，the sensors回指前面的sensor，a shared network引出后文this linked network。
exp.other: soil moisture 土壤湿度；sensor 传感器；reading 测量读数；in real time 实时。
exp.meaning: 至少核对两侧：前文的人和物在候选句中有没有明确承接？候选句又是否为后文this linked network提供来源？泛泛谈某种应用的主题关联比这种双向回指弱。
exp.rest: 照片分享应用也属于农业数字技术，但没有承接开发传感器的人，也不能解释this linked network；降雨分布和传统记录方式均缺少双向承接链。

skill: 过程承接 + This lack of coordination
q:
前文：The regional train and bus operators publish separate schedules. Passengers often miss a connection when one service runs late.
【空缺】
后文：This lack of coordination persuaded the council to introduce a common timetable.
哪一句最自然？
o: The operators bought more comfortable seats for several long-distance services.
Mobile apps help tourists discover nearby restaurants and shops.
Neither operator adjusts its departure times when the other's service is delayed.
The council's new office opened beside the railway station last summer.

exp.trans: 前文指出火车和公交时刻表各自独立，乘客因此误车；正确句补充双方遇到延误也不调整衔接班次；后文的this lack of coordination便有明确指代对象。
exp.structure: Neither operator是主语，adjusts是谓语；when从句补充触发条件。后文This lack of coordination概括了这种双方未协调的行为。
exp.other: timetable 时刻表；connection 换乘衔接；departure time 发车时间；adjust 调整。
exp.meaning: 这种题不是谁的主题词多谁正确，而是候选句是否构成后文this/these抽象名词可总结的具体事实，并与前文的矛盾同向。
exp.rest: 座椅改善和附近商店虽与交通有关，却无法解释协调缺失；办公室搬迁也不构成换乘失误的直接原因。

target: 表面便利 vs 参与不足
skill: 讽刺语气 + 对比过渡
q:
前文：The online course called itself interactive, but students could do little more than click Next after each recorded lecture. The easiest part was operating the screen; the hardest was staying awake.
【空缺】
后文：What would genuine participation require? Students could challenge arguments and revise one another's work.
哪句最适合？
o: The screen's simplicity proves that the course already offers full participation.
By contrast, a redesigned course could let students contribute arguments instead of merely consuming lectures.
Video lectures are cheaper to store than printed textbooks.
Some courses include subtitles in several languages.

exp.trans: 前文用带讽刺性的说法指出所谓互动课仍只让学生被动点下一页；正确句转向让学生真正贡献观点的另一种课程；后文追问真正参与需要什么。
exp.structure: but建立宣称interactive与实际只能click Next的矛盾；the hardest was staying awake暗示被动乏味；By contrast引出另一模式，contribute arguments与后文challenge/revise形成衔接。
exp.other: interactive 互动的；lecture 讲座/课；challenge an argument 质疑论点；revise 修订。
exp.meaning: 看到操作很简单，不能自动判为作者赞扬。应结合转折、夸张和后文提问判断作者真正评价：被动消费不足，主动参与才是重点。
exp.rest: 简单操作证明充分互动与but students could do little more相反；储存成本和字幕虽与网课有关，却不解释后文genuine participation。

target: 单向展示→反向参与→后文设问
q:
前文：At the old science museum, visitors watched a machine demonstrate each experiment. The most demanding thing they could do was press the Start button.
【空缺】
后文：What counts as taking part in an experiment? Visitors must be able to change a variable and compare the results.
哪一句最适合？
o: The museum's historical building has been repaired many times.
The simple controls made the demonstrations easier for young children to watch.
Every machine had a colorful label describing its inventor.
A redesigned exhibition could reverse this passive arrangement by inviting visitors to conduct their own tests.

exp.trans: 旧科技馆由机器单向演示，观众几乎只能按开始按钮。正确句引出新展览如何扭转这种被动观看，让观众亲自试验；后文再问什么才是真正参与实验。
exp.structure: 前文visitors watched与could do ... press Start显示参与程度极低；正确句reverse this passive arrangement回指前文整体模式，conduct their own tests引出后文taking part in an experiment和change a variable。
exp.other: demanding 费力的/要求高的；demonstration 演示；variable 变量；conduct a test 进行试验。
exp.meaning: 最有力的证据是双向：反转被动的安排承接前文，主动测试又引出后文讨论。‘最难任务只是按按钮’在语境中揭示参与不足，不是对设备的夸赞。
exp.rest: 场馆维修、标签介绍、控制简单都不能完成被动到主动的论证转折；即使表面上与展览有关，也不构成后文提问的直接来源。
